categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates high-speed railway passenger transportation services, including the Beijing-Shanghai High-Speed Railway and several other high-speed rail lines in Anhui province. It provides passenger transport services and network services such as track and contact network usage to other railway operators. Additionally, it engages in consulting, equipment procurement and sales, property management, logistics, warehousing, and parking services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced high-speed rail technologies with design speeds of 350 km/h, including the use of EMU (Electric Multiple Unit) trains and state-of-the-art signaling and control systems. It employs a delegated transportation management model, leveraging mature operational expertise from entrusted railway bureaus. The company also invests in intelligent operation and maintenance systems, energy-saving technologies, and smart station construction to enhance operational efficiency and safety.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are passengers traveling on the high-speed rail lines and other railway companies that use the company's rail infrastructure and services. The company serves major metropolitan areas including Beijing, Shanghai, Tianjin, and cities in the Yangtze River Delta, catering to both long-distance and regional travelers. It also serves other railway operators by providing track and power network usage services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in eastern China, covering the Beijing-Shanghai corridor and several high-speed rail segments in Anhui province. Its network connects major economic zones such as the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region and the Yangtze River Delta, including cities like Beijing, Tianjin, Shanghai, Nanjing, Hangzhou, Hefei, and others. The rail lines form part of the national 'eight vertical and eight horizontal' high-speed rail network.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the railway transportation supply chain. It owns and manages railway infrastructure and provides passenger transportation services directly to end customers, as well as infrastructure usage services to other railway operators. It does not engage in upstream manufacturing but relies on suppliers for equipment and materials.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing high-speed rail operational efficiency, safety, and service quality through technological innovation and intelligent systems. The company focuses on energy-saving and low-carbon technologies, smart station development, and integrated operation and maintenance platforms. It actively participates in industry standard setting and pursues R&D in railway technology, securing patents and software copyrights to support sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through passenger ticket sales for trains operated as the train service provider and fees charged to other railway companies for using the company's rail lines and power supply infrastructure. Additional income comes from commercial services at stations and ancillary businesses such as property management and logistics. The company also receives government subsidies related to infrastructure and research projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position as the operator of one of China's most important and busiest high-speed rail corridors, with significant network advantages and high technical standards. It competes indirectly with other high-speed rail operators in China but benefits from its strategic location and integration within the national rail network. Its main competitors are other state-owned railway companies operating in overlapping or adjacent regions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported operating revenues of approximately RMB 42.16 billion in 2024, representing a 3.62% increase year-over-year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 12.77 billion, up 10.59%. Total assets stood at about RMB 284.66 billion with a slight decrease from the previous year, while net assets increased by 3.81% to RMB 202.4 billion. The company maintains stable cash flows and continues to invest in infrastructure and technology upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its superior network location connecting major economic hubs, advanced high-speed rail technology with world-class standards, and a strong safety record with 13 consecutive years of stable operation. It differentiates itself through high-quality, efficient, and reliable passenger services, integrated network advantages, and continuous innovation in intelligent rail operations and energy management. Its brand is well recognized domestically and internationally for safety, speed, convenience, and comfort.
